text:
maya: Heads-up — PR #482 (changelog + release notes for model-catalog deprecations) is blocked by the docs preview. CI/mkdocs is failing with a 404 for a model-catalog link and it's preventing the build. Can someone help debug?

alex: Link + CI log? happy to take a look briefly.

maya: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482
Here's the mkdocs excerpt from the GH Actions run:
```
WARNING - 404 Not Found: 'model-catalog/v1.2/index.md' -> /model-catalog/v1.2/
Documentation build aborted with 1 warning.
```
The changelog also contains the deprecation note for `rdm-llm-quantize` that should stay, but the broken link is to the model-catalog migration guide.

docs-bot: Preview build failed: https://docs-preview.internal/preview/482 — check logs for broken links.

sam: I can run the preview locally. Which branch is this on? Also, is the link supposed to be `/model-catalog/1.2/` (no `v`)?

maya: Branch is `docs/changelog-model-deprec-482`. The original author linked to `/model-catalog/v1.2/`. I think we standardized on `/model-catalog/1.2/` in the nav back in July.

julie: quick note — release embargo for this set is until tomorrow 09:00 PT. We can't merge before that (legal/compliance). After 09:00 we can merge; pref schedule merge at 09:30 PT if everything passes.

luis: Also request: add a tiny migration SDK snippet calling the new model alias, so customers know how to change `model="rdm-llm"` -> `model="rdm-llm-quantized"` with the new quantization warning. Even a 3-line Python snippet in the changelog would help.

sam: I cloned the branch and reproduced the error. Fix is trivial — update the link to the canonical path in the docs nav + a small redirect. Pushing a tiny commit now to the branch: `fix: model-catalog path (v1.2 -> 1.2)` and re-running preview.

sam: New preview: https://docs-preview.internal/preview/482/try-2 (build started)

docs-bot: Preview build succeeded: https://docs-preview.internal/preview/482/try-2 — all links valid.

maya: Thanks @sam :tada: — I added Luis's SDK snippet to the changelog text and updated the migration bullet to call out the API change and a short example.

maya: Snippet I added (Python):
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
# Old: model="rdm-llm" -> New alias/model name for quantized runtime
resp = client.generate(model="rdm-llm-quantized", prompt="Translate to FR: Hello")
print(resp.text)
```

julie: Quick wording nit: call out that `rdm-llm-quantized` is still experimental and provide the fallback policy link. Otherwise LGTM.

luis: Looks good to me — thanks for adding the snippet. No functional objections.

sam: Can @julie and @alex give a quick LGTM so we can merge after embargo? I'll squash the tiny fix commit.

alex: LGTM, nice catch on the nav mismatch.

julie: LGTM with my tiny wording nit addressed (already updated in the branch). Please squash.

maya: Great — plan: squash and merge at 09:30 PT tomorrow, post-release notes to #announcements after merge. I'll add a changelog entry in the release notes about the deprecation + migration steps.

sam: I'll queue the merge and watch the release embargo window. If anything else pops up I'll ping here.

maya: Thanks everyone! :rocket:
